resolution.note: krn task forwarded via the host entry fails closed (exit 78) unless it runs the pinned .krn/product-release at origin/main; krn doctor reports entry and commits; host entry switched

title: Route krn task to a pinned Product checkout
body:
`~/.config/krn/product-entry` points at the lead working checkout, so `krn task` runs whatever commit is checked out there; on an older commit the frontier fails and claims run without the lock (review N4/A1). Route the entry to a checkout that only moves to `origin/main` (e.g. a detached release worktree updated after each merge) or to an installed Product release.
Acceptance: switching the working checkout to another branch does not change the code `krn task` runs; doctor reports the entry commit.

2026-11-08 research (t-cz92be6): acceptance detail: the entry fails closed with the exact fix when it runs a stale or mismatched build, naming the entry commit, the release commit and a `which -a krn` hint (OR5 in .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/lanes/t3-orchestration.md, after t3code's launcher protocol preflight); before moving the pinned checkout, check the candidate and record the previous commit for a one-step rollback (RD04 in t3-rules-docs.md).
